topic: Scale of plant milk against dairy milk
claim_a: Kitchens: plant milks about 4.1% of milk litres on Kamereo; top plant SKU about 3% of the top dairy SKU (ECR-06)
claim_b: Consumer marketplaces: top plant SKU 60% (Lazada) and 79% (Tiki) of the top dairy SKU by litres (MKT-03; MKT-05)
position_taken: Both stand: different buyers. Households buy domestic nut and soy milks near dairy scale; cafes and restaurants buy dairy and a little imported oat
notes: Top-SKU ratios only; neither is a market share

claim_a: Plant powders are 2 of 25 powders and 1.7% of counters at WheyShop (ECR-08)
claim_b: On Lazada, 7 plant powder listings show 7,294 sales against 5,455 for 6 whey listings; the top plant listing is Vietnamese-made (MKT-03)
position_taken: Both stand; neither is representative. WheyShop counters are shop-set; Lazada rows are built from targeted queries
notes: Plant powder is a real online niche, but these data cannot size it

topic: Which soy milk brand leads online
claim_a: Tiki: Vinasoy Fami leads (27,855 cases for one SKU; Vinamilk soy milks at most 558) (MKT-05)
claim_b: Lazada: Vinamilk leads (14,800 cases of walnut soy milk; Vinasoy Store at most 1,600) (MKT-03)
position_taken: Both stand: platform-specific distribution; Metric's Shopee data (ECR-01) give Vinamilk 53.6% of liquid milk
notes: Do not read either platform as a brand share

topic: Whether e-commerce is only an incumbents' channel
claim_a: Wave 8: official brand stores take 84.7% of liquid-milk sales on Shopee, so e-commerce is an incumbents' channel, not a cheap launch route for a new brand (ECR-01; W8-L5)
claim_b: On Lazada, 99% of dry chay piece sales and 81% of frozen and chilled chay sales in our rows go through small specialist shops without official badges (MKT-03)
position_taken: Both stand: incumbents' channel for milks and processed meat; small-maker channel for chay dry goods
notes: Share figures are our calculation on the rows read
